verdict.rationale: CockroachDB exposes a documented public SQL API over the PostgreSQL wire protocol, usable from any Postgres driver, and a community user confirms reusing Postgres clients works. Cluster management is scriptable through the documented `ccloud` CLI and an official MCP server with OAuth or API-key auth. Missing for 10: no documented REST/management API or machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of candidate OpenAPI paths returned 404), and no hands-on corroboration of programmatic cluster control beyond the CLI and MCP docs.
